title: Gujarat civic polls: BJP sweeps Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation, wins 38 of 44 seats - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
The BJP on Tuesday registered a sweeping victory in the Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation (GMC) elections, winning 38 of the 44 seats, and retained power in the Thara and Okha municipalities in Gujarat, according to results announced by the State Election Commission.
In Gandhinagar, the Congress emerged as the second-largest party with five seats, while one seat was won by an independent candidate. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), which had managed to win one seat in the previous GMC elections, failed to open its account this time.
The last GMC elections were held in October 2021, when the BJP had won 41 of the 44 seats. The Congress had secured two seats, while the AAP had bagged one.
In Banaskantha district’s Thara municipality, the BJP won 19 of the 24 seats, while the Congress secured the remaining five seats.
In Devbhumi Dwarka district’s Okha municipality, the BJP won 29 of the 32 seats where polling was held. The Congress managed to win three seats.
Four seats in Okha were declared uncontested as only BJP candidates remained in the race. Including these four seats, the BJP secured 33 of the total 36 seats in the municipality and retained control of the civic body.
With these results, the BJP continued its hold over all three urban local bodies that went to polls on Sunday.
The counting of votes for the three civic bodies began at 9 am on Tuesday.
The GMC elections were held for all 44 seats across 11 wards, with 130 candidates contesting the polls. The civic body has around 2.59 lakh registered voters.
In Thara municipality, elections were conducted for 24 seats across six wards, while Okha saw voting for 32 seats across nine wards.
According to the State Election Commission, Gandhinagar recorded a voter turnout of 59.25 per cent, while Thara and Okha registered 81.18 per cent and 63.27 per cent turnout, respectively.
The elections were conducted through Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs).
